scope: SHELL in-plane plate atlas; exact common geometry, clamped entire perimeter. All contacts on actual top surface. Separate reference-grid variation is recorded, never called physical ground truth.
metric: Unweighted common material-probe Frobenius norm; not a continuum area-integrated L2. VM is maximum over these declared probes and two surfaces.

selected_atlas_sum.scope: Actual two separated contacts; one RHS per selected feature mesh plus common-probe tensor sum. Reuses precomputed loads and factors.
